requirements.text: Present to managing directors and business owners and take them from interesting demo to daily use
Work in person at customer sites in Munich or London
English at C1 level or above
Learn new industries, data and business terms fast
Model business logic such as margins, costs, stock and pricing
Hands-on experience with real company data in analytics, BI or controlling
Consulting or client-facing project experience across industries
Software implementation at customers so the product actually gets used
Own a portfolio of customers end to end
Break messy problems into clear parts and explain exactly how a number came about

resumes.text:
Julia Brandt
Munich, Germany

Summary
Consultant and controlling analyst with eight years of client work across manufacturing, retail and logistics. English at C1 level (CAE certified) and conversational French at B2. I am comfortable presenting to owners in their office and then working alongside shop-floor teams for the rest of the week.

Experience
Senior Consultant, Brackmore Consulting, Munich, March 2021 to present
- Lead client projects for mid-sized manufacturers, from scoping to handover.
- Present findings each month to managing directors and owners. For a fittings maker, a dashboard I built went from demo to the daily production meeting within six weeks.
- Work on site at client plants in Munich and Stuttgart several days a week.
- Own a portfolio of five client accounts end to end, including roadmap and budget reviews.
- Built margin, cost, stock and pricing models that showed one client a 9 percent gap in product profitability.
- Within two weeks of each new engagement I can explain the client's production flow and key terms back to the owner.
- Every number I deliver comes with a traceable calculation sheet. I split messy requests into three or four clear questions before touching any data.

Controller, Verlen Industrie AG, Augsburg, June 2016 to February 2021
- Hands-on analysis of ERP and controlling data for monthly close and variance reporting.
- Rolled out a planning tool to the finance teams of three customers; adoption reached 90 percent of users within a quarter.

Education
M.Sc. Business Administration, Hallmere University, 2016
B.A. Economics, Ostfeld University, 2013

Skills
Client presentations, business modelling, controlling, ERP reporting, project management, English (C1), French (B2)

Tobias Wenzel
Berlin, Germany

Summary
Finance manager with nine years in controlling and reporting for German industrial companies. Native German and fluent English (C1, Cambridge Advanced). I like to explain numbers simply to colleagues who do not work in finance.

Experience
Finance Manager, Kestler Werkzeugbau GmbH, Berlin, April 2019 to present
- Run the monthly close and variance reporting for three plants.
- Present the monthly results to the managing director. The format I introduced is now used at every board meeting.
- Work remotely from my Berlin home office and visit the plants once a quarter.
- Responsible for the budget of one internal cost centre, reviewed with the controlling team every quarter.
- Internal business partner for the HR department on headcount planning.
- When a result falls short of plan, I break the question into smaller parts and show each step of the calculation so anyone can check it.
- Over the years I have moved into several departments and learned their vocabulary within about a month.

Senior Controller, Oberland Systems GmbH, Hamburg, 2014 to 2019
- Hands-on analysis of ERP and BI data for monthly management reporting.
- Implemented a planning tool at two customers and trained their finance teams until the monthly process ran inside the tool.

Education
B.A. Business Administration, Ostfeld University, 2012

Skills
Management reporting, budgeting, variance analysis, ERP reporting, stakeholder communication, English (C1), German (native)

Carmen Ortiz
Leeds, United Kingdom

Summary
Registered nurse with seven years on hospital wards in Leeds. English at C1 level and native Spanish. Calm under pressure, and good with patients and their families.

Experience
Staff Nurse, St Aldric's General Hospital, Leeds, 2018 to present
- Care for patients on a surgical ward of 28 beds across day and night shifts.
- Trained in six hospital departments in eighteen months and picked up each ward's routines within a week.
- Lead the handover between shifts so that every patient's observations and medication are passed on clearly.
- Introduced a new rostering app to the nurses on my ward and handled their questions during the first month.
- Record medication administration and patient observations in the hospital's clinical system.

Healthcare Assistant, Ferndale Care Home, Bradford, 2015 to 2018
- Assisted residents with washing, dressing and meals.
- Kept handwritten logs of food and fluid intake for each resident.
- Worked weekends at a family bakery in Leeds, reconciling the daily cash register against supplier invoices.

Education
Bachelor of Science in Nursing, Northern Borders University, 2017
First Aid at Work certificate, renewed annually

Skills
Patient care, clinical documentation, shift handover, first aid, team leadership, English (C1), Spanish (native)
